_comment: Soul larvae spawn-and-flow at Acheron near-shore. See [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]]. Slot mode: initial_population scatters 6 aged larvae across authored slot positions at the shore; when a slot's occupant dies, the next fresh trickle targets THAT specific slot and (after the inward-burn delay) becomes aged in the same spot. The queue feels lived-in -- positions persist across kills.
_comment_spawn_region: Tags actors as limbo-owned for AI-barrier ownership. Cosmologically larvae belong to Limbo's law-domain, not chapel_interior's -- they live on Limbo's floor, eternally awaiting Charon. Owning region is FOREIGN to the chapel_interior-owned descent-corridor barrier, so the barrier correctly blocks them from climbing the stairs. Visible spawn pos is unchanged (controlled by spawn_position above); only the ownership label moves.
_comment_spawn: The pile spot. The pile is the centuries of dissolved soul-substance, the cosmological clog made visible. Hell's broken delivery mechanism produces new souls by re-coalescing them out of the pile's substance -- the pile IS the production mechanism. Fresh larvae literally emerge from the pile at this position, then crawl south to whatever queue-slot is vacant at the riverbank. ONE location for the pile mesh AND the spawn point AND the visible-emergence event -- one cosmological role rendered as one spot. Adjust the position if you F3 a better pile placement.
_comment_stop_range: 0.1m -- tight enough that the larva fully reaches its slot rather than parking 0.5m short. Was 0.5 originally; meant 'near enough' but visually read as 'didn't arrive' because the actor stopped before the authored position. Tighter range = exact position match.
_comment_target_mode: Slot mode: each fresh's scripted target is the first vacant slot from initial_population.positions. Kill a feral on the far left, the next fresh crawls there. Lived-in queue.
_comment_on_arrival_clip: Crawl-bite arrival pose: fresh that walked to a dead aged's body crouches over it and bites. Cosmologically the feeding-as-conversion: the imprint drives the fresh to consume the dissolved sangue, the act of feeding IS the inward-burn made physical, and the tint-burn (white -> sangue red over the wait) reads as the corpse's sangue moving into the fresh. zombie_biting_2 is the crawl-prone bite (not the standing zombie_biting feeder pose). Released on archetype swap when applyArchetypeSwap clears action_state.

initial_population._comment: Two populations rendered as one queue: (1) the standing aged at the riverbank facing the water -- eternally awaiting Charon, 6 slots from earlier F3-captured positions; (2) two FEEDERS crouched at the pile (X=0, Z=-368), futilely biting the dissolved sangue per [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]] feeder doctrine. Feeder slots use larva_aged_feeder archetype via the per-slot 'archetypes' array. The visual tableau: standing queue at the river, prone feeders at the pile inland of them. Yaws face the water for standing aged; feeders face inward (yaw=pi=facing-north back into the queue, so they're hunched over the pile's center). When a feeder dies, the slot is filled by a standing aged on the next trickle (v1 limitation: the flow-level on_arrival_action is uniform; per-slot conversion targets deferred until needed twice).
initial_population._comment_on_arrival_actions: Per-slot conversion target. Empty entries fall back to the flow-level on_arrival_action (convert_to:larva_aged). Feeder slots convert fresh -> larva_aged_feeder so the slot's visual role persists across kill-and-respawn cycles -- kill a feeder, the next fresh arrives and resumes feeding rather than standing.
